newsitem.title: USA: MOODY'S UPS ALLSTATE CORP AND UNIT'S DEBT.
newsitem.headline: MOODY'S UPS ALLSTATE CORP AND UNIT'S DEBT.

text.p: NEW YORK, August 4 - Moody's Investors Service has raised its insurance financial strength rating on Allstate Insurance Company, to Aa2 from Aa3, and the long-term debt, preferred stock and insurance financial strength ratings of various other affiliates of The Allstate Corporation. The outlook for these ratings remains positive.

Moody's has also confirmed the short-term ratings for The Allstate Corporation and for Allstate Life Insurance Company at Prime-1. According to Moody's, these ratings are based on Allstate's formidable competitive position in the U.S. market for personal insurance, its strong core earnings and good financial position.

Allstate distributes its products nationally primarily through an extensive network of employee agents, and enjoys strong name recognition. Moody's noted that in recent years, Allstate has made strides in increasing operating efficiency and productivity; improving underwriting results; actively reducing its substantial catastrophe exposures; and more clearly focusing on its core businesses.

Commenting on its upgrade of the ratings of Allstate's life insurance companies (Allstate Life Insurance Company, Northbrook Life Insurance Company, Glenbrook Life and Annuity Company, Lincoln Benefit Life Company, and Allstate Life Insurance Company of New York -- insurance financial strength to Aa2 from Aa3) the rating agency noted the Allstate brand name, the implicit support of the Allstate Insurance Company, and reinsurance agreements between Allstate Life and its life insurance subsidiaries (with the exception of the New York company) as key rating considerations.
Moody's also noted the recent improvements in the group's sales momentum for annuity and life insurance products, as well as stronger earnings and capitalization.
These improvements have been driven by the Allstate Life group's extensive, multi-channel distribution network, which include the Allstate agent.
The group's focus on highly competitive and generally volatile accumulation, pension and structured settlement products offset these improvements somewhat.

The following ratings were upgraded: The Allstate Corporation - Senior debt to A1, from A2; senior debt shelf to (P)A1, from (P)A2; subordinated debt shelf to (P)A2, from (P)A3; cumulative preferred shelf to (P)"a1," from (P)"a2"; and non-cumulative preferred shelf to (P)"a2," from (P)"a3"; Allstate Financing I and Allstate Financing II - Preferred stock to "a1," from "a2"; Allstate Financing III and Allstate Financing IV - cumulative preferred shelf to (P)"a1," from (P)"a2"; and non-cumulative preferred shelf to (P)"a2," from (P)"a3";

Allstate Insurance Company - Insurance Financial Strength to Aa2 from Aa3; Allstate Life Insurance Company - Insurance Financial Strength to Aa2 from Aa3; Allstate Life Insurance Company of New York - Insurance Financial Strength to Aa2 from Aa3;

Northbrook Life Insurance Company - Insurance Financial Strength to Aa2 from Aa3; Glenbrook Life and Annuity Company - Insurance Financial Strength to Aa2 from Aa3; Lincoln Benefit Life Company - Insurance Financial Strength to Aa2 from Aa3; The Short-Term Debt ratings of The Allstate Corporation and Allstate Life Insurance Company were confirmed at Prime-1.

The Allstate Corporation, through subsidiaries, is a leading U.S. property/casualty and life insurer. Based in Northbrook, Illinois, Allstate had consolidated revenue of $12.3 billion and net income of $1.4 billion for the six period ended June 30, 1997.
